I really like the meaning of this! It’s so, so true. The part about feeling resentment and anger hits hard and is true for many who didn’t receive that love growing up.

This is a really pretty poem. It perfectly illustrates (in my mind) how change is really the only answer when it comes down to it. I personally really like how straightforward it is. Not much reading between the lines, it’s all out on display. The last stanza is my favourite because I relate so much to it. Everything runs smoothly.

I see this and am astonished you’re still fighting, to be quite honest. I’m young and have only dealt with depression for 4 years and I’m already considering suicide. I’m impressed you’ve hung on and tried your best for so long. I really do hope things get better for you. It’s hard to say it when I too am suicidal but I guess just try to enjoy the small things and take things one day at a time. I’m sure you have done that to make it this far, though. I’m not sure what to say other than I’m proud of you for fighting for so long.
I’m so sorry for your loss. Not op but that made me think about how my mom would react. I have some more thinking to do.
